text:
Situation: Dacarbazine has been on FDA's drug shortage list since 2021-10-20 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 60 months. Corvale East holds 33 units of the 200 mg vial (9.1 days) and 11 units of the 10 mg/mL 10 mL vial (2.9 days). Corvale General holds 38.07 units (13.3 days) and 45.03 units (15.8 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 9 units of the 10 mg/mL vial (9.7 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA posted the shortage on 2021-10-20. An inspection of Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022) ended 2020-05-18 and was classified OAI; the classification letter is dated 2024-05-22. A second inspection of the same plant ended 2022-06-30 and was also classified OAI; the classification letter is dated 2024-04-30. A later inspection ended 2023-08-24 and was classified VAI. The Fresenius Kabi NDC 63323012710 is manufactured at this plant per the label.

Our position: Corvale General can spare 3 units of the 200 mg vial while retaining approximately two weeks of supply. This transfer would extend Corvale East's coverage to approximately 6 days. Alternate Hikma and Fresenius Kabi presentations are pharmacist-approved for concentration or vial size changes. Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. product is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 3 units of dacarbazine 200 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Purchase dacarbazine from Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. — approved by buyer.
3. Use Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. dacarbazine 200 mg/1 vial (NDC 00143924510) per pharmacist verification — approved by pharmacist.
4. Use Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC dacarbazine 10 mg/mL vial per pharmacist verification — approved by pharmacist.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
